title: Migrating a Content Source Without Rebuilding the Site
excerpt: Change the source, keep the pages. How a per-model provider switch makes content migrations boring.

data.heading: Migrating a Content Source Without Rebuilding the Site
data.body: When the content source changes, the frontend should not notice. Here is how NexusContent makes that a configuration change.

data.heading: The old way
data.body:
Most migrations rewrite templates, move URLs, and re-map fields. The page component that consumed WordPress objects needs a different version for Strapi objects and a third for repository files.

That compounding work is what NexusContent removes. Providers normalize everything into the same shapes, so components never change.
